order_shipped_chk.name: order_shipped_chk
order_shipped_chk.value: "order"."status" not in ('shipped', 'completed') or "order"."tracking_number" is not null

media_dims_chk.name: media_dims_chk
media_dims_chk.value: "media"."width" between 1 and 10000 and "media"."height" between 1 and 10000 and "media"."bytes" between 1 and 5242880

job_lock_chk.name: job_lock_chk
job_lock_chk.value: ("job"."status" = 'running') = ("job"."locked_by" is not null and "job"."locked_until" is not null)
